title: AI Video Ad Creator +  Copywriter + Visual Asset Designer
description:
The opportunity


We’re building a high-output creative engine for paid ads-and we’re looking for a specialist who can write the words that sell and turn them into scroll-stopping short-form video ads using AI video tools, strong editing, and performance thinking.


This is not a “make pretty videos” role. This is concept → copy → creative → iterations → winners .

If you live at the intersection of genAI + storytelling + conversion copywriting , this role is for you.


You’ll create AI-driven video ads and visual assets for campaigns across TikTok, Instagram Reels/Stories, YouTube Shorts, Meta, and more. We optimize for ROAS, CTR, CVR, hook rate, hold rate, and retention -and the copywriting is a core lever in every asset we ship.


What you’ll do


You own the creative from message to motion-including the copywriting .

Copywriting + creative strategy

  • Write conversion-focused short-form scripts (15-45s) : hooks, problem framing, proof, offer, CTA.
  • Create multiple copy angles per concept (pain-based, benefit-based, curiosity, contrarian, founder POV, social proof, demo-driven).
  • Write and version hook lines, VO scripts, on-screen text, captions, headlines, end-card CTAs , and thumbnail copy.
  • Translate product benefits into clear, punchy, platform-native messaging (no fluff, no generic AI-sounding copy).
  • Apply direct-response frameworks (Problem → Agitation → Solution, Before/After, Myth-busting, Objection handling, etc.) with modern pacing.

Video production + asset creation

  • Produce short-form ad creatives designed for conversion (tight cuts, retention-first pacing, pattern interrupts).
  • Create AI-generated video sequences and combine them with real footage/UGC where needed.
  • Generate visual assets for ad variations: thumbnails, product scenes, backgrounds, overlays, cutdowns, motion graphics, end cards.
  • Build multiple versions of the same concept (different hooks, copy angles, pacing, captions, VO, formats).
  • Work from a brief and deliver fast iterations based on performance feedback.
  • Maintain brand consistency while still pushing creative boundaries.
  • Collaborate with growth/marketing to align creative with testing strategy and learnings.


Minimum requirements (non-negotiable)


To be considered, you must meet the requirements below and include proof in your application:

  • Resume must be written in English.
  • You must share examples of your AI video ad work with VO and Dialogue (not just AI visuals).
  • Copywriting is required: you must provide evidence you wrote/owned the scripts and ad copy for at least some of the work you share (scripts, hook lists, on-screen text, captions, or a short case study describing your role).
  • You must provide at least ONE of the following:
  • Evidence you produced creatives that generated strong ROAS / conversion lift (screenshots, case study, or summary metrics), OR
  • A video you produced that achieved 10,000+ views , OR
  • Proof you can create complex AI short-form ad videos (not basic slideshow edits-think narrative, scene continuity, ad pacing, multiple AI shots, strong compositing).
  • You have managed or been part of a social media account with 10,000+ followers .


What “qualified” looks like (skills we’re actively looking for)


You don’t just edit-you communicate and convert.

  • You understand what makes a video ad perform: thumb-stopping hooks, clear messaging, pattern interrupts, pacing, proof, offer structure, CTA clarity .
  • You can write direct-response copy that sounds human, specific, and brand-right-not generic “AI marketing” language.
  • You can create AI-driven visuals that look intentional and brand-ready (not uncanny or generic).
  • You can edit like a performance creator: tight cuts, retention-first pacing, captions, kinetic typography, sound design.
  • You have a repeatable workflow to deliver high volume with high quality (and keep assets organized).


Tools & workflows (use what you’re best at)


We’re tool-agnostic, but you should be highly capable with several of the following:

AI + creative

  • AI video generation (e.g., Runway, Pika, or comparable tools)
  • AI image generation (e.g., Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, etc.)
  • Voice & audio (AI voiceover tools, sound design, music selection, cleanup)

Editing + delivery

  • Editing & motion (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, etc.)
  • Creative versioning + organized file delivery (naming conventions, aspect ratios, exports)

Copywriting workflow (important)

  • You can work quickly in tools like Docs/Notion , and you know how to build:
  • Hook banks
  • Script variations
  • Angle matrices
  • Offer/CTA libraries
  • Caption + primary text variants aligned to the video


Deliverables & expectations


Typical output: 10 ad creatives per month (depending on campaign cycle), plus variations.

Format mastery: 9:16 primary , plus 1:1 and 16:9 cutdowns when needed.

You can deliver:

  • Final exports (platform-ready)
  • Project files when requested
  • Source assets used (AI outputs, overlays, audio references)

Copy deliverables (required):

  • Script + VO text (or structured script outline)
  • Hook variations (often 5-15 per concept)
  • On-screen text + caption plan (what appears when, and why)
  • End card copy + CTA variants
  • Optional: primary text/caption variants for Meta/TikTok where needed

Turnaround: fast iteration is key (often 24-72 hours per revision cycle , depending on scope).


How we evaluate success


  • Your creatives clearly map to an angle + message and drive action.
  • Iterations improve performance (hooks improve, retention improves, CTR/CVR improves).
  • Your output is consistent, organized, and easy to test at scale.
  • Your copy + editing work together (the words and visuals reinforce the same conversion story).

﻿

Compensation


Competitive and flexible based on experience and proof of performance.

Per project bases

If you’re a performance-minded AI creative who can write high-converting scripts and ship high-quality ads fast -and you have proof-apply with the items above.

About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning.   • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.

  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.

description:
We’re one of the fastest-growing Shopify-based DTC brands in the world at the forefront of all things hydrogen water.


Our product line includes hydrogen water bottles, supplements, and accessories all designed to help people recover faster, reduce inflammation, and feel their best.


We’re looking for a Performance Video Editor who deeply understands how to cut direct response ads for Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. This is NOT a branding video role we’re talking scroll-stopping hooks, retention-driven pacing, and revenue-first editing.


Compensation & Perks:

  • Base Salary from $1,700-$2,400 USD per month + Performance Bonus (Depending on experience and skillset)

  • 2+ years experience editing direct response video ads for DTC brands
  • Portfolio of paid ads you've edited (Meta, TikTok, YT Shorts — performance-focused)
  • Advanced skills in Adobe Premiere, After Effects, or equivalent

What you'll be doing:

  • Edit short-form performance videos (15–90 seconds) optimized for Meta and TikTok
  • Implement scroll-stopping hooks, fast-paced edits, dynamic subtitles, and retention overlays
  • Work closely with our Creative Strategist and UGC Project Manager to execute on weekly ad briefs
  • Repurpose UGC content, testimonials, and influencer clips into winning ad angles
  • Apply performance data to iterate and improve ad creatives week over week

Apply directly via LinkedIn

Attach your resume and portfolio of previous works

We’re looking to hire immediately — so if you’re an editor who gets performance, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Analytics Architect
description:
Analytics Architect


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks/ Fabric. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of big data technologies, data engineering, and cloud computing, with a strong focus on Azure Databricks along with Strong SQL.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders and other IT teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
  • Oversee the end-to-end implementation of data solutions, ensuring alignment with business requirements and best practices.
  • Lead the development of data pipelines and ETL processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and other relevant tools.
  • Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services (e.g., Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory) and on-premise systems .
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the data engineering team, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Ensure proper documentation of architecture, processes, and data flows, while ensuring compliance with security and governance standards.
  • Ensure best practices are followed in terms of code quality, data security, and scalability.
  • Stay updated with the latest developments in Databricks and associated technologies to drive innovation.


Essential Skills:

  • Strong experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake.
  • Proficiency in big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) and data processing frameworks (e.g., PySpark).
  • Deep understanding of Azure services like Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory. Power BI, SSRS, SSAS, PSKU to F SKU.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing, and building data lakes.
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems like Git.
  • Knowledge of cloud security best practices.


Soft Skills:

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
  • Leadership skills with the ability to manage and mentor a team of data engineers.


Nice to have Skills:

  • Power BI for dashboarding and reporting.
  • Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration tasks.
  • Spark Streaming for processing real-time data streams.
  • Familiarity with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates for infrastructure as code (IaC) practices.

title: Incubadora Cristã busca Desenvolvedor Full Stack
description:
Localização: Remoto

Horário : Sabádo, 4 horas por semana por 4 semanas.

Contrato: Trabalho Voluntário, Estágio Gratuito

Benefícios:

  • Certificado demonstrando experiência com empresas americanas;
  • Aprendizado de metodologias e ferramentas avançadas de IA;
  • Contato com investidores-anjo e empregadores americanos.

Inglês: Venha aprimorar e avaliar sua proficiência.

Vagas Abertas: Seis vagas.


Visão Geral


A Catholic Coders Guild treina talentos e incuba aplicativos cristãos sem fins lucrativos, contando com uma larga rede de programadores, empregadores e investidores americanos. Nossa missão é melhorar o Curriculum Vitae de desenvolvedores cristãos , de modo que estes se destaquem no mercado de trabalho.


Programadores brasileiros com experiência internacional por vezes obtêm salários de 2 a 5 vezes mais altos quando comparados com programadores sem experiência internacional. A Catholic Coders Guild é a solução para esta internacionalização.


Ao final do workshop, nossos voluntários brasileiros se beneficiam de nossa rede de investidores-anjo e empregadores americanos, aprendizado sobre IA, e um certificado demonstrando experiência com trabalho para empresas e institutos americanos.


A Catholic Coders Guild está procurando um Desenvolvedor Web Full Stack com habilidades e experiência em Next.js/React e tecnologias relacionadas para auxiliar em nossos projetos de desenvolvimento web e IA.


Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com nossa equipe de designers, desenvolvedores e pesquisadores para transformar conceitos em realidade. Esta função exige uma compreensão aprofundada das tecnologias de desenvolvimento web, experiência prática com IA, paixão por codificação e um compromisso com a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade e escaláveis.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web usando Next.js, React e outros frameworks e bibliotecas JavaScript modernos.
  • Projetar e implementar serviços de back-end e APIs para alimentar as aplicações web.
  • Trabalhar com modelos e técnicas líderes de IA para suportar e potencializar as funcionalidades essenciais.
  • Trabalhar com PostgreSQL para armazenamento e gerenciamento de dados, garantindo a integridade e o desempenho dos dados.
  • Colaborar com designers de UI/UX para traduzir designs e wireframes em código de alta qualidade.
  • Otimizar aplicações para máxima velocidade e escalabilidade .
  • Implementar medidas de segurança e proteção de dados .
  • Participar de revisões de código (code reviews) e testes de unidade (unit testing) para garantir robustez, usabilidade e confiabilidade .
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tecnologias emergentes de web/IA e as tendências da indústria .
  • Aproveitar a IA para auxiliar de forma responsável nos desafios diários de codificação.


Habilidades/Qualificações


  • Proficiência sólida em JavaScript , incluindo manipulação de DOM e o modelo de objeto JavaScript.
  • Experiência extensa com Next.js e React , incluindo configuração/implantação de build.
  • Sucesso demonstrado na execução de todo o ciclo de vida do projeto , desde o conceito/protótipo até a implantação.
  • Compreensão de modelos, arquitetura de IA e aplicação de ferramentas de IA em projetos.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e bancos de dados vetoriais .
  • Sólida compreensão de PostgreSQL e experiência com design e gerenciamento de bancos de dados.
  • Familiaridade com APIs RESTful .
  • Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (preferencialmente Git).
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias front-end , como HTML5 e CSS3, bem como experiência com frameworks como TailwindCSS .
  • Compreensão de renderização do lado do servidor (server-side rendering) e seus benefícios e casos de uso.
  • Capacidade de identificar interações de usuário baseadas na web e desenvolver componentes de interface de usuário altamente responsivos .


Experiência Preferencial


a. De 1 a 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento web full-stack, com um portfólio forte de projetos demonstrando experiência na construção de aplicações web usando Next.js .

b. Experiência prática na integração de modelos e frameworks de IA em ambientes de produção.

c. Experiência com serviços de cloud como Vercel, Cloudflare, Netlify, AWS ou Google Cloud.

d. Familiaridade com protocolos de segurança web e proteção de dados.

e. Experiência com ferramentas CI/CD para implantação e gerenciamento de aplicações.

  • f. Capacidade comprovada de trabalhar em um ambiente de equipe colaborativo e gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.

title: DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer (Azure / SOC 2 Operations)
description:
Overview

At Aclarian, we empower local governments with innovative, web-based ERP software solutions designed to streamline operations and drive efficiency. Our modern platform replaces outdated accounting systems, eliminating manual processes and redundancies to meet the demands of today’s digital landscape. We are committed to continuous innovation, evolving our software with cutting-edge technology and industry best practices to ensure our clients remain leaders in public sector effectiveness.


We are seeking a hands-on DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer to assist with Azure environment management, pipeline automation, and SOC 2 compliance operations. The role focuses on improving and maintaining secure, automated infrastructure — not manual deployments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and maintain Azure resources, including AKS, SQL, Storage, Service Bus, and Key Vault.
  • Review, modify, and create GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines to support .NET Core and Angular microservices.
  • Assist developers with environment configuration and deployment workflows.
  • Implement and document security best practices (RBAC, SSH key management, Key Vault usage, Defender for Cloud).
  • Support SOC 2 audit readiness by generating infrastructure evidence (access logs, configurations, backups, and monitoring settings).
  • Maintain monitoring and alerting through Datadog and Azure Monitor.
  • Perform operational checks — validating backups, verifying scaling rules, ensuring service uptime, and patching images when required.
  • Improve automation scripts using PowerShell or Bash for recurring operational tasks.


Requirements

  • Strong understanding of Azure infrastructure, especially Kubernetes (AKS), networking, and identity management.
  • Experience working with GitHub Actions, Docker, and Helm.
  • Ability to read and edit YAML workflows for CI/CD.
  • Familiarity with SOC 2 security principles — least privilege, change management, monitoring, and backup verification.
  • Experience with PowerShell and Bash.
  • Detail-oriented and proactive in finding and implementing improvements.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Datadog, Azure Defender, or Vanta.
  • Understanding of .NET Core and Angular build processes.
  • Previous exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits.


Engagement

  • Contract or long-term / part-time role.

title: Bilingual DevOps Engineer Remote
description:
DevOps Engineer


Job Description

We are seeking a qualified DevOps Engineer to join our infrastructure team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing Kubernetes-based systems in our on-premises data center, handling everything from bare metal hardware and networking to database administration and application deployment. You will address the unique challenges of operating a private cloud, including optimizing AI model operations, CI/CD pipelines, and integration with Enterprise Java and Python services. This role involves hands-on operation of production data center racks, ensuring flawless performance and scalability for our AI-based applications.

Design, deploy, and maintain Kubernetes clusters using Helm diagrams for orchestration and configuration management.

Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines with Git, Jenkins, and related tools to automate testing, integration, and deployment processes. Manage Postgres and NoSQL databases, including performance tuning, backups, scaling, and security configurations. Manage physical hardware in our data center racks, including provisioning, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintaining servers and network components.

Implement, monitor, and manage enterprise Java and Python applications, ensuring compatibility with our AI models and infrastructure.


Skills

Advanced english level. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 3+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, or systems administration, specializing in Kubernetes and container orchestration. Strong command of Helm for Kubernetes application management. Hands-on experience with Git and Jenkins for developing and managing CI/CD pipelines. Experience administering Postgres databases, including query optimization, replication, and disaster recovery. Knowledge of Enterprise Java and Python programming for application support and scripting. Exceptional mastery of the Linux operating system.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect


Role: Senior Software Engineer


Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.


About the role

Own critical services, mentor engineers, and interface with clients. Ship API-first Python systems, automate dispute/chargeback workflows, and run reliable data pipelines on AWS and Kubernetes with Terraform-managed infra.


Responsibilities

  • Lead projects, designs, and reviews; mentor junior/mid engineers.
  • Build and operate REST APIs in Python (versioning, idempotency, auth/OIDC, webhooks).
  • Automate ops: evidence assembly, reconciliations, SLA timers, notifications, approvals.
  • Design ETL/ELT (batch/streaming), data contracts, schema evolution, backpressure.
  • Model data with SQLAlchemy on MySQL/Postgres; use ClickHouse and S3/Parquet.
  • Run services on AWS with Docker + Kubernetes (Helm/Kustomize, GitOps optional).
  • Define infrastructure with Terraform (modules, state, policy checks).
  • Add observability (logs/metrics/traces), CI/CD with GitHub Actions, safe rollouts.
  • Collaborate with teams on API contracts, performance, and security.
  • Integrate device intelligence and bot-mitigation with privacy controls.


Required

  • Python expert (3.12+ preferred): typing/mypy, async/multiprocessing, testing, profiling.
  • Proven REST API design and operations at scale.
  • Payments/fintech: disputes/chargebacks, reconciliation, integrations.
  • Orchestration/workflows and event-driven patterns; human-in-the-loop.
  • AWS, Docker, Kubernetes in production; GitHub Actions; observability.
  • Terraform in production (modules, remote state, policy as code).
  • Strong SQL; SQLAlchemy; columnar DBs (e.g., MySQL, ClickHouse).
  • Systems basics: networking/HTTP/TLS, concurrency, performance.


Nice to have

Kafka/Kinesis/SQS, Airflow/Prefect/Dagster, PCI/SOC 2, and FastAPI/Flask.


How to apply

Send an English resume and links to APIs/code/docs showing Python, Terraform/Kubernetes, Angular, automation, and payments/chargebacks work.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Serviços
description:
Resumo do cargo:

O Engenheiro de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sitemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);
  • Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas , diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;
  • Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
  • Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
  • Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
  • Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
  • Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
  • Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
  • Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.


Quem você é:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

About Turing:

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

  • Identificar proativamente falhas e avarias em equipamentos, propondo soluções práticas e imediatas para mitigação de riscos;

  • Realizar testes de poço e emitir boletins de testes;

  • Reportar acidentes, incidentes e condições inseguras;

title: Infrastructure Engineer (Azure • Elixir)
description:
Infrastructure Engineer (Azure • Elixir)



Who We Are Seeking:


We seek a talented and experienced DevOps/Distributed Systems Engineer to operate and harden our Elixir services and Hyperledger Besu nodes network on Microsoft Azure. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. 



Your Role and Responsibilities will be to design, set up, and operate:


  • Elixir stack – Elixir/OTP, Phoenix, Ecto, Oban, and OpenTelemetry nodes and services.

  • Besu on Azure – validators/peers, permissioning, bootnodes, IBFT/QBFT configs, genesis updates, hard-fork rollouts, RPC/WS endpoints behind Azure gateways.

  • Storage & performance – tune Besu (JVM/RocksDB), use Premium SSD v2 / Ultra Disk, optimise IOPS/throughput, and set up snapshot/restore via Azure Blob Storage.

  • Networking – secure VNets/subnets with Azure CNI (Cilium), NSGs, Private Endpoints/Private Link, NAT Gateway, and VNet peering/ExpressRoute.

  • Traffic & ingress – expose RPC/WS via Azure Application Gateway or Nginx Ingress with WAF, mTLS, rate limiting, and IP allowlists.

  • Secrets & keys – manage validator keys and app secrets using Key Vault / Managed HSM, Managed Identities, and least-privilege RBAC via Entra ID.

  • CI/CD & GitOps – deliver immutable releases with GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, ACR (signing/scanning), Helm, and Argo CD or Flux.

  • Observability & SRE – Azure Monitor + Log Analytics, Managed or self-managed Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry traces, alerting, runbooks, SLOs and error budgets.

    • Essential Qualifications:  


    • 5+ years in DevOps/SRE/Platform roles running distributed systems in production.
    • Strong Azure background: AKS, VNet/NSG/Private Link, Key Vault, ACR, Azure Monitor/Log Analytics, and Application Gateway/WAF.
    • Solid Linux and networking fundamentals (TLS, DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing).
    • Proven observability practice: metrics, logs, traces, actionable alerting, SLOs/runbooks.
    • Excellent written and spoken English (daily collaboration across teams).

We believe that world-class software can only be created by a motivated and enthusiastic team in an environment that fosters creativity and free thinking. title: Data Engineer
description:
About Exactius

Exactius works with companies to solve complex digital marketing challenges and achieve ambitious growth goals. We bring executive leadership and cross-functional execution teams that can not only form the strategy but can execute and deliver the result. These teams always include a proven performance marketing CMO, along with campaign and CRM managers, conversion and product managers, data scientists, front/back end developers, and creative teams as necessary. Those teams are supported by a proprietary technology that supports the need for advanced analysis and real-time optimization. Exactius is an extension of your internal teams with one goal in mind: grow faster and be more profitable.


Description

As a Data Engineer at Exactius, you will contribute to the design, development, and operation of a cloud-native data platform that supports large-scale data ingestion, transformation, and analytics workloads. You will build and operate reliable, production-grade data pipelines and shared data services, with a strong focus on scalability, automation, and system robustness.

You will work extensively with cloud infrastructure, orchestration frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines to standardize data ingestion patterns, enforce data quality, and improve observability across the platform. The role emphasizes platform thinking: building reusable components, enforcing engineering standards, and enabling multiple teams to consume data safely and efficiently.

You will collaborate with data engineers, analytics engineers, and infrastructure teams to evolve the data platform architecture, reduce operational overhead, and ensure high availability, performance, and security of data systems.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL pipelines to process and manage large datasets efficiently.
  • Ensure data pipelines are optimized for performance and reliability.
  • Develop and maintain data models using dbt, adhering to best practices in data warehousing.
  • Integrate with third-party APIs and develop services to enable seamless data access.
  • Deploy and scale data infrastructure using cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure).
  • Implement and manage workflows using Airflow or similar orchestration tools.
  • Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless deployment, testing, and automation.
  • Apply software engineering principles to enhance data solution maintainability and scalability.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data needs and deliver reliable, actionable solutions.
  • Work closely with marketing and advertising teams to enable data-driven decision-making (preferred).

Requirements

  • At least 2 years as a Data Engineer, with a strong focus on SQL, data warehouse modeling, and dbt .
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and scripting.
  • Experience in integrating with third-party APIs or designing APIs for data access.
  • Experience with Git for version control and Docker for containerization.
  • Hands-on expertise with cloud platforms (GCP , AWS , or Azure ).
  • Familiarity with Airflow for workflow orchestration.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
  • Knowledge of digital marketing or advertising (A plus).
  • Enthusiasm about learning and adapting to the exciting world of Al - a commitment to exploring this field is a fundamental part of our culture.


Benefits & Perks

  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high growth international brand
  • Work remote from anywhere in the world
  • Control your time - flexible hours

description:
PO Junior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Estamos em busca de um Product Owner Junior dinâmico e orientado para resultados. Você será responsável por apoiar a condução de um time de desenvolvimento de produto digital, garantindo a entrega de valor ao cliente. Seu papel fundamental será alinhar expectativas, colaborar diretamente com o time e acompanhar todas as fases do ciclo de desenvolvimento, servindo como uma ponte essencial entre as necessidades do negócio e a execução técnica.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Ponto focal: Atuar como o elo entre o cliente e o time, garantindo o alinhamento constante de expectativas e requisitos.
  • Gestão de Backlog e Roadmaps: Conduzir a criação e manutenção de roadmaps, priorizando o backlog conforme os objetivos do cliente e as necessidades dos usuários.
  • Ritos Ágeis: Acompanhar o time em cerimônias (sprints, reviews, dailies) para assegurar o cumprimento de prazos e escopo.
  • Estratégia de Produto: Apoiar na definição da estratégia, colaborando na geração de soluções que atendam às demandas do negócio.
  • Facilitação: Garantir a comunicação fluida entre designers, desenvolvedores e stakeholders, assegurando que as histórias de usuário (User Stories) estejam claras.
  • Mapeamento e Análise: Conduzir o mapeamento de processos e fluxos do cliente, além de acompanhar métricas de desempenho para orientar decisões baseadas em dados.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Conhecimento Técnico: Domínio de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e capacidade de criar roadmaps e priorizar backlogs.
  • Comunicação: Habilidade de comunicação clara e eficaz (escrita e verbal) para atuar como ponto focal e facilitar a relação com o cliente.
  • Organização e Gestão: Capacidade de organizar e priorizar demandas em um ambiente dinâmico, com atenção aos detalhes para garantir a qualidade das entregas.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Facilidade para colaborar com diferentes áreas (design, dev, negócios).
  • Perfil Comportamental: Profissional colaborativo, organizado, que tenha curiosidade para aprender as regras do setor e facilidade para traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos claros para o time técnico.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver familiaridade com frameworks de criação de features e user stories .
  • Possuir habilidade comprovada para conduzir o mapeamento de processos e fluxos do cliente.

title: Sales Executive - Shipyards & Shipowners
description:
Job Title: Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners

Department: Sales


Role Summary


The Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners will play a key role in M&O Partners’ commercial growth by representing our suppliers’ products and services to shipyards and shipowners across the maritime and offshore sectors. Reporting directly to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore and working closely with the Sales Manager , this position focuses on identifying new business opportunities, strengthening client relationships, and supporting the successful introduction of supplier solutions to shipbuilding, conversion, and vessel maintenance projects.

The Sales Executive will engage directly with shipyards, vessel owners, and technical teams, delivering value-based proposals and ensuring M&O’s solutions are well-positioned to meet client needs and project requirements.


Key Responsibilities

Product & Solution Representation

  • Develop a deep understanding of the suppliers’ products and their applications within shipbuilding, repair, and conversion projects.
  • Provide technical and commercial presentations tailored to shipyards and shipowner requirements.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier technologies, certifications, and industry standards.

Business Development

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with shipyards, shipowners, and related stakeholders in the maritime and offshore markets.
  • Build and manage a pipeline of qualified prospects through proactive outreach, industry networking, and relationship building.
  • Convert leads into sales opportunities and manage the full sales process from initial contact to contract closure.
  • Expand M&O’s presence within key accounts, ensuring continuous engagement and satisfaction.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Insight

  • Monitor market trends, shipbuilding projects, fleet expansions, and dry-docking activities across the region.
  • Analyze competitors’ positioning, pricing, and service offerings to identify differentiation opportunities.
  • Share market insights and customer feedback with internal teams and supplier partners to guide strategic decisions.

Sales Strategy & Reporting

  • Support the development and execution of sales strategies aligned with M&O’s objectives in the marine and offshore sectors.
  • Maintain accurate records of opportunities, client interactions, and pipeline status within the CRM system.
  • Provide regular reports on sales activities, forecasts, and market developments to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore.


Skills and Competencies

  • B2B Sales Expertise: Proven track record in technical, industrial, or maritime sales.
  • Client Relationship Management: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and long-term partnerships with shipyards, shipowners, and technical teams.
  • Technical & Market Knowledge: Understanding of marine equipment, systems, or components used in shipbuilding and vessel maintenance.
  • Negotiation & Commercial Acumen: Skilled in managing bids, pricing discussions, and contract finalization processes.
  • Strategic Thinking: Capable of identifying business opportunities through market analysis and strategic planning.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver value-driven commercial solutions.


Experience Requirements

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in B2B technical or industrial sales, preferably within the maritime, shipbuilding, or offshore sectors.
  • Experience managing relationships with shipyards, vessel owners, or marine equipment suppliers .
  • Familiarity with procurement processes and technical specifications for marine and offshore projects.
  • Background in mechanical, electrical, or marine engineering is a plus.

With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.

As a Scrum Master – Appian, you will lead and facilitate all core Agile ceremonies while serving as a delivery leader responsible for ensuring sprint commitments are met with high quality and predictable throughput. You will partner closely with Product Owners, engineers, QA, DevOps, and business stakeholders to translate high-level business concepts into detailed technical user stories. You will actively identify, escalate, and remove impediments, track and communicate team performance using Agile metrics, and champion Agile principles to continuously mature team practices in a complex technical environment.


Responsibilities:


  • Lead and facilitate all core Agile ceremonies, including Daily Standups, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
  • Serve as a delivery leader, ensuring sprint commitments are met while maintaining high quality and predictable throughput.
  • Actively identify, escalate, and remove delivery impediments across teams.
  • Track, analyze, and communicate team performance using Agile metrics.
  • Champion Agile principles and continuously mature team practices.
  • Partner with Product Owners, technical leadership, and stakeholders.
  • Author clear, technically accurate user stories, including Appian, DevOps, and QA-related work.
  • Translate high-level business concepts into detailed technical stories.
  • Collaborate with engineers and QA teams to ensure feasibility and testability.


Required Experience:


  • Strong experience as a Scrum Master with significant Appian experience.
  • Hands-on experience with the Appian low-code platform.
  • Proven ability to train and mentor teams and drive process improvement.
  • Demonstrated Agile leadership in complex technical environments.
  • Strong knowledge of DevOps workflows and QA/testing practices.
  • Excellent communication skills in English.


Preferred Qualifications:


  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, or equivalent.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.

  • Excellent English communication skills

title: Analista de Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
  • Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;
  • Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
  • Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
  • Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
  • Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
  • Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas fiscais e ERPs SAP Diferencial.

  • Tradução e Desenvolvimento Técnico: Converter conceitos criativos e temas propostos pelo Estilista em desenhos técnicos, modelagens e acabamentos detalhados para as coleções.

  • Interface de Viabilidade: Trabalhar de forma integrada com Comercial, Marketing e Produção para garantir que a tradução do design respeite a viabilidade técnica e os objetivos de negócio.
  • Guardião da Consistência Criativa: Zelar pela qualidade técnica e consistência estética das coleções, garantindo que o produto final reflita fielmente a identidade visual da marca.
  • Ajuste de Performance: Utilizar feedbacks de mercado e análises de performance das coleções para aplicar melhorias técnicas contínuas no desenvolvimento de novos produtos.

title: Desenvolvedor .Net
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar soluções utilizando .NET Core e C#
  • Trabalhar com serviços da AWS, incluindo Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudWatch, CloudFormation, RDS, SNS e SQS.
  • Contribuir para a arquitetura de microserviços.
  • Gerenciar bancos de dados SQL Server e PostgreSQL.
  • Implementar e monitorar soluções usando Redis e DynamoDB.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de desenvolvimento, incluindo injeção de dependência, orientação a objetos e design patterns.
  • Utilizar Docker para conteinerização de aplicações.
  • Realizar testes unitários e de integração para garantir a qualidade do software.

Local de trabalho: Botafogo - RJ (3x presencial 2 home office)

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

É buscar a excelência, é fazer acontecer. É ser talentoso, inteligente, curioso e aceitar qualquer desafio. É se apresentar e defender as suas ideias. É colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar e ser apaixonado pelo que faz.

Porque somos digitais, mas também somos humanos. Se você, assim como nós, acredita que investimento não é sinônimo de terno e gravata, queremos conhecer você!

A empresa que investe em você! Descomplicamos o mercado financeiro para que nossos clientes consigam tomar boas decisões na hora de investir.

Buscar os melhores resultados para os clientes;

Ser apaixonado pelo que faz;

Aprender e melhorar sempre.

title: Network Engineer Commissioning Specialist (BSC/RNC), OSS and Sites
description:
We are looking for a Wireless Specialist with solid experience in mobile networks, responsible for commissioning, integration, and validation of Controllers (BSC/RNC), as well as operation and management of OSS platforms and support for field activities related to telecommunications sites.

This professional will work directly throughout the deployment, expansion, and optimization cycle of the network, ensuring performance, availability, and compliance with the client's technical requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • (Must-have).Perform commissioning, integration, testing, and troubleshooting of 2G/3G/4G/5G, Controllers (BSC/RNC) and OSS.
  • Execute configuration, expansion, and technical audit activities on OSS platforms.
  • Support and accompany field activities related to the activation of new sites, swaps, migrations, and network expansions.
  • Ensure correct implementation of parameters, scripts, and integration routines.
  • Monitor network KPIs and alarms, identifying and proactively resolving faults.
  • Prepare technical reports, action plans, and network documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with planning, O&M, and optimization teams to ensure network performance and stability.
  • Provide technical support during maintenance windows and critical activation processes including SWAPs.

Technical Requirements:

  • Proven experience with BSC and/or RNC Controllers (any vendor: ZTE, Ericsson, Nokia, Huawei).
  • Knowledge of OSS and network management tools.
  • Strong understanding of commissioning, integration, and troubleshooting processes for 2G/3G/4G/5G networks.
  • Solid knowledge of RF, parameters, handovers, features, and network architecture.
  • Ability to interpret logs, KPIs, and performance reports.
  • Experience with integration scripts (MML, CLI, or equivalent).
  • Desirable experience with O&M interfaces and network databases.
  • Knowledge of field processes: Survey, Swap, and site activation.

Desired Profile:

  • Analytical, organized, and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Clear and objective communication with clients and internal teams.
  • Ability to work under pressure and during critical maintenance windows.
  • Proactive and collaborative attitude.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
  • Certifications or training related to mobile networks will be considered an advantage.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties:

You'll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We're looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards.
  • Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability.
  • Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.
  • Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly.
  • Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.

Nice to have:

  • Postgraduate or Master's degree.
  • Spanish proficiency.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Heads of Sales - Getu Gastro LTDA
description:
Job Title: Head of Sales (Sales Manager)

Department: Sales

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer

Location: Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Brazil

Employment Type: Full-Time, CLT ou PJ

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on, results-driven Head of Sales to lead and scale our commercial operations in Brazil. This is both a strategic and operational role, ideal for someone who can design sales strategies and execute them personally.

You will be working in a startup environment, not a corporate structure. This means high autonomy, fast decision-making, direct customer contact, and the flexibility to step outside your job title when needed. In addition to defining the sales strategy, you will be actively involved in prospecting, client visits, negotiations, and closing deals.

This role is critical to the company's growth. You will have a direct impact on revenue generation, team building, and the development of scalable sales processes as the company expands.

Key Responsibilities Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth
  • Develop, implement, and continuously optimize clear, measurable sales strategies
  • Define priorities by region, product, and customer segment
  • Actively drive revenue through calls, on-site visits, and negotiations
  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities
  • Adapt strategies quickly based on real-world market feedback
Field Sales Execution
  • Personally visit clients and prospects when required
  • Open new accounts through cold outreach and door-to-door visits
  • Support and close strategic and high-value negotiations
  • Represent the company professionally in the field
Team Leadership & Coordination
  • Coordinate daily with internal sales reps, freelancers, and partners
  • Set targets, KPIs, and execution plans
  • Lead from the front with active selling and field presence
  • Train, motivate, and hold the team accountable for results
CRM, Processes & Reporting
  • Work in a structured manner with the CRM system (HubSpot is essential)
  • Monitor pipeline, conversion rates, ticket size, and individual performance
  • Report results, forecasts, and action plans to management
  • Ensure sales activities align with operational and logistical capacity
Startup & Operational Support
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced startup with changing priorities
  • Understand core operational and logistical processes to support sales execution
  • Support operations when needed to remove bottlenecks
  • Collaborate closely with finance, operations, and marketing teams
  • Contribute to improving internal processes as the company scales
Requirements Must-Have
  • Proven experience as a Head of Sales, Sales Manager, or senior B2B sales professional
  • Strong ability to build and execute sales strategies
  • Comfortable with frequent calling and door-to-door sales
  • Highly results-driven and accountable
  • Flexible mindset suited to a startup environment
  • Fluent Portuguese and good English skills
  • Solid CRM and pipeline management experience (HubSpot is essential)
Nice-to-Have
  • Experience in horeca, wholesale, FMCG, or food & beverage
  • Experience in early-stage or scaling companies
Compensation & Rewards
  • Competitive base salary
  • Strong performance-based bonus structure
  • Clear and direct link between results and compensation
  • Long-term growth opportunities as the company scales
Who This Role Is For

This role is for someone who:

  • Thrives in a startup environment
  • Is flexible, hands-on, and solution-oriented
  • Builds strategies and executes them personally
  • Is motivated by performance-based rewards
  • Takes full ownership of sales performance and outcomes

title: International Buyer
description:
General Description

The Buyer will be responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and assisting in the management of the inventory for the landing gear MRO operations. This role will require a high level of attention to detail, an understanding of the aerospace industry, and the ability to work effectively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery of materials, components, and parts for maintenance and repair services.

Detailed Description

Procurement of Materials & Parts:

  • Source and purchase materials, components, and parts required for landing gear MRO operations.
  • Evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost, lead times, and reliability.
  • Ensure all purchases meet the required specifications and are compliant with industry standards and regulations (e.g., FAA, EASA).

Inventory Management:

  • Assist in the maintenance of optimal inventory levels with warehouse team to support continuous MRO operations while minimizing excess stock and potential obsolescence.
  • Help warehouse team if necessary, in the tracking and monitoring of the stock usage, reordering materials and components as necessary.

Supplier Relationship Management:

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and vendors to ensure high-quality products and timely deliveries.
  • Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions with suppliers to ensure competitive sourcing and cost savings.

Quality Assurance & Compliance:

  • Work closely with the quality control and engineering teams to ensure that all materials and parts purchased meet the required standards for safety and performance.
  • Monitor and address any quality issues, returns, or discrepancies with suppliers.

Data Entry & Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate records of all purchasing transactions, including purchase orders, invoices, and delivery schedules.
  • Prepare regular procurement reports to track spending, inventory levels, and supplier performance.

Collaboration & Cross-functional Support:

  • Collaborate with maintenance, engineering, and other departments to identify material needs and ensure procurement aligns with operational requirements.
  • Provide support to project teams by ensuring the timely availability of materials for scheduled landing gear maintenance projects.

Cost Control:

  • Monitor and control procurement costs to meet budget targets and contribute to cost-saving initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and cost efficiencies in procurement activities.

Qualification Minimum Requirements

Work Experience:

At least 3-5 years of experience in procurement or purchasing, ideally in an aerospace, MRO, or manufacturing environment.

Knowledge of landing gear systems, aerospace components, and regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA) is a significant advantage

Educational:

Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, Business, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field preferred.

Fluent/advanced English

Technical Skills:

Proficient in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, etc.).

Knowledge of inventory management systems and ERP tools is a plus. (Oracle and quantum)

Soft Skills:

Strong negotiation and communication skills.

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: Tax Coordinator
description:
The Regional Tax Coordinator will support the global tax function with end‐to‐end ownership of multi‐jurisdiction tax compliance, controversy, and operational readiness. The role encompasses direct and indirect taxes, withholding tax and treaty management, transfer pricing oversight, and implementation of new global regimes such as Pillar Two.

The coordinator will drive strategic tax planning initiatives that optimize the effective tax rate and cash taxes while ensuring robust compliance, operational substance, and scalable controls and automation. This position partners closely with finance, controllership, treasury, legal, and business teams to support new transactions, products, and market entries and to proactively assess permanent establishment and nexus risks.

RESPONSABILITIES

i. Ensures timely and accurate tax compliance across all in‐scope jurisdictions, including corporate income taxes, indirect taxes such as VAT, GST, ICMS, and ISS, and withholding tax returns and information reporting.

ii. The role owns the global tax calendar and filing controls, establishing standard operating procedures and clear accountabilities to maintain a consistently high on time filing rate and audit readiness.

iii. Map tax opportunities and risks, proposing and implementing tax planning initiatives and corporate restructurings aimed at tax efficiency and reduction of the overall tax burden.

iv. Act in a consultative capacity with business areas, treasury, and controllership, providing support on tax-related matters and new transactions.

v. Monitor changes in local and international tax legislation and ensure the implementation of internal improvements to comply with new regulations.

vi. Lead internal and external tax audits and inspections with authorities in Brazil and other jurisdictions, managing controversy strategies and external advisors to achieve efficient, defensible outcomes.

vii. Analyze due diligence reports and provide support for strategic projects, such as the development of new products and M&A transactions.

viii. Develop and monitor robust internal controls to mitigate tax risks.

ix. Prepare reports and documentation to support senior management in tax-related matters.

QUALIFICATIONS

i. Bachelor's degree in accounting, law or related area

ii. Minimum 8 years of experience, (Big 4 or public company experience preferred)

iii. Language: English, advanced / Spanish, desirable

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

i. Strong knowledge of global tax laws, cross-border regulations, and transfer pricing principles.

ii. Proficiency with tax preparation software and ERP.

iii. Experience with Financial institutions is desirable

SOFT SKILLS

i. Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

ii. Effective planning and priority setting

iii. Must be well organized and detail-oriented

iv. Teamwork

v. Clear and effective written and verbal communication

vi. Interpersonal and presentation skills

vii. Analytical skills

title: Java Fullstack Developer (Angular)
description:
About You

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You're motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You're looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
  • Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and Bedrock.
  • Experience using MyBatis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of RxJS and Observables.
  • Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
  • Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using RxJS and Observables.
  • Implement and manage data persistence using PostgreSQL, MyBatis, Liquibase, and Redis.
  • Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, CloudWatch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
  • Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations

*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.

Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.

The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG's software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.

The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.

Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.

Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.

Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.

No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we're reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you'll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.

About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit
